27755	def _wrap_kernel_sig(name: str, param_lines: List[str]) -> str:
27756	    """Render ``void <name>_step_kernel(<param_lines...>, int n) {`` with
27757	    historical 23-space alignment (column matches the legacy hand-formatted
27758	    source for every optimizer)."""
27759	    indent = " " * 23
27760	    parts = [f"void {name}_step_kernel({param_lines[0]}"]
27761	    for p in param_lines[1:]:
27762	        parts.append(indent + p)
27763	    parts.append(indent + "int n) {")
27764	    return "\n".join(parts)

27767	def _wrap_launch_sig(indent_width: int, param_lines: List[str]) -> str:
27768	    """Render the parameter body of ``extern "C" void launch_<name>_step(...)``
27769	    using per-optimizer ``indent_width`` (preserved from the hand-formatted
27770	    legacy source). ``param_lines`` already includes the trailing ``int n,``
27771	    entry; the surrounding base template supplies the ``cudaStream_t`` /

27773	    indent = " " * indent_width
27774	    parts = [param_lines[0]]
27775	    for p in param_lines[1:]:
